import concurrent.futures
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = ROOT / 'build/audit-blas'
PY = str(OUT / 'env/bin/python')
COMPILER = str(ROOT.parent / 'pystachy-audit-gc-budget/pystachy')
LLVM = str(ROOT.parent / 'llvm18-recovered/usr/lib/llvm-18/bin')
FIXTURES = ROOT.parent / 'pystachy-audit-nanogpt-training/build/audit-nanogpt/fixtures'
ENV = {k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('PYSTACHY_')}
ENV.update(PATH=LLVM+':'+ENV['PATH'], PYSTACHY_LLVM=LLVM, PYSTACHY_HOME=str(ROOT), PYSTACHY_JOBS='2', OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1', OMP_NUM_THREADS='1')

def run(job):
    name, argv, extra = job
    start = time.monotonic()
    try:
        p = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=ROOT, env=ENV | extra, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=900)
        result = dict(command=argv, environment=extra, returncode=p.returncode, stdout=p.stdout, stderr=p.stderr)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
        result = dict(command=argv, environment=extra, timeout=900, stdout=str(e.stdout), stderr=str(e.stderr))
    result['wall_seconds'] = time.monotonic()-start
    (OUT/(name+'-command.json')).write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+'\n')
    print(name, result.get('returncode'), result['stdout'][-700:], result['stderr'][-500:], flush=True)
    return result

parity = [PY,'tools/check_nanogpt.py','--fixtures',str(FIXTURES),'--python',PY,'--blas-library','/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libblas.so.3','--warmups','1','--repeats','3']
jobs = [
 ('blas',[PY,'examples/ndarray/check_blas.py','--compiler',COMPILER,'--stress','1','--json',str(OUT/'blas.json')],{}),
 ('make-blas',['make','blas-check','PY='+PY,'BENCH_COMPILER='+COMPILER],{}),
 ('tool-tests',[PY,'-m','unittest','discover','-s','tools','-p','test_check_nanogpt.py'],{}),
 ('nano',parity+['--compiler',COMPILER,'--json',str(OUT/'nano.json')],{}),
 ('nano-gc',parity+['--compiler','env PYSTACHY_GC_STRESS=1000 '+COMPILER,'--json',str(OUT/'nano-gc.json')],{'PYSTACHY_GC_STRESS':'1','PYSTACHY_GC_STRESS_PROGRAM':'1'}),
]
for case in ['one_token','batched_bias','batched_no_bias']:
    jobs.append(('numpy-'+case,[PY,'tools/nanogpt_numpy_baseline.py','--fixtures',str(FIXTURES),'--case',case,'--warmups','1','--repeats','3','--json',str(OUT/('numpy-'+case+'.json'))],{}))
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
    results = list(pool.map(run,jobs))
assert all(r.get('returncode') == 0 for r in results)
